description: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy of two language models—GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini—in reflecting instilled preferences, under three experimental conditions: Control (gray), Before Introspection Training (light blue), and After Introspection Training (dark blue), as indicated by the legend in the upper left. The horizontal axis categorizes the models, with GPT-4o on the left and GPT-4o-mini on the right, while the vertical axis, labeled “Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences),” spans from 0.00 to 1.00 on a linear scale with major ticks at 0.25 intervals. For GPT-4o, the Control bar reaches approximately 0.10, the Before Training bar rises to about 0.60, and the After Training bar peaks near 0.80. For GPT-4o-mini, the Control bar is similarly low at ~0.10, the Before Training bar is slightly lower at ~0.55, and the After Training bar reaches just under 0.75. Error bars are present atop each bar, indicating variability, with the largest error observed for the GPT-4o Control condition. Across both models, self-report accuracy increases monotonically from Control to After Training, with the most substantial relative gain occurring in GPT-4o-mini (from ~0.55 to ~0.75) compared to GPT-4o (from ~0.60 to ~0.80), suggesting greater sensitivity to introspection training in the smaller model. Bars are grouped side-by-side per model without sorting or visual emphasis, maintaining a consistent visual structure across categories.
caption_used: The bar chart illustrates the self-report accuracy related to instilled preferences for two models, GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, under different training conditions. The categories are displayed along the X-axis and include GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini, arranged in this order. The value axis is vertical, labeled as 'Self-Report Accuracy (Instilled Preferences)' and ranges from 0.00 to 1.00 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.25. Each model category is represented by three bars: gray for 'Control,' light blue for 'Before Introspection Training,' and dark blue for 'After Introspection Training,' as indicated in the legend situated at the left top corner. For GPT-4o, the gray bar is the shortest, at approximately 0.10, the light blue bar is around 0.60, and the dark blue bar is nearly 0.80. For GPT-4o-mini, the gray bar is about 0.10, the light blue bar is approximately 0.55, and the dark blue bar is slightly lower than 0.75. In both models, the 'After Introspection Training' condition has the highest accuracy, with the 'Control' condition having the lowest. Notably, the improvement from 'Before Introspection Training' to 'After Introspection Training' is more pronounced in GPT-4o-mini compared to GPT-4o, suggesting that the smaller model benefits more significantly from introspection training. Bars are grouped side by side within each model category, without any specific sorting, and no bars are visually emphasized.
